decisions.reason: The client questions using a spout and requests gravity-based dispensing, but it is unclear whether the spout is eliminated or retained as the outlet of a gravity-fed mechanism. Removing the existing spout geometry attributes is therefore not safely entailed.
Changing the dispensing drive to gravity-based does not alter the existing requirements to prevent leakage into the base or electronics.
The source does not change the cleanability requirement or prescribe a different cleaning method; a gravity-based dispenser still requires a sanitary fluid path.
The gravity-based dispensing request does not change the general V1 priority or off-the-shelf sourcing policy, and it does not establish whether the new mechanism will be custom or off-the-shelf.
